attributes.name: Blessing of the Prince of Lies
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Bury this card and all cards in your hand to succeed at your check against a boon or a non-villain bane, then draw up to your hand size.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile does not have the Corrupted trait, banish this card instead of discarding or burying it.
